answer: A bond is refunded only after 49 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The summit counter is kept in tide and glacier reveals each reset. An hostile operator as a result has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 49 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. That is 1491 dollars of sunk cost for a share worth less than the deposit itself. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
